The '''Eeropha system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eeropha]] and its seven [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including [[Nierport VII]]. During the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] Eeropha and Nierport VII served as refueling stops for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] along the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], and during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] Eeropha was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]].
